summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward extreme long-term bullishness on the S&P 500, evidenced by massive premium allocations to SPX 6000C and 7000C strikes expiring in 2026 and 2028. Significant directional conviction is visible in the persistent accumulation of SPX 6000C (exp 2026-06-18) and 7000C (exp 2026-09-18), which have seen billions in inflows over the last three sessions. While semiconductor names like MU and AMD show aggressive intraday call buying (P/C ratios of 0.41 and 0.24 respectively), the primary institutional driver is a multi-billion dollar bet on long-term index expansion. Traders should watch for continued volatility in SPX as these massive LEAPS positions act as a heavy directional anchor, and monitor if the high-premium call buying in MU and AMD translates into momentum or if it represents hedging against upcoming earnings.
